'''Metarr''' was a type of [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] that could be [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuras III]]. It was one of the base components of [[carbon-metar]].<ref name="PotG3" />
